in_marathi.name: Nanku
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nanku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nanaka', meaning 'one who bestows grace'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Hanuman, the divine monkey god who represents strength, courage, and devotion.

in_bengali.name: Nanku
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Grace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nanku একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nanaka', meaning 'one who bestows grace'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Hanuman, the divine monkey god who represents strength, courage, and devotion.
